title: BEST NMN Supplements (2026 Top Brands Review)
abstract:
## What Are the Types of NMN Available?  
There are two forms of NMN available which are: α-NMN (alpha-nicotinamide mononucleotide) and β-NMN (beta-nicotinamide mononucleotide). The active form of NMN is known as β-NMN or nicotinamide mononucleotide.  
([Source](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2090123221001491))
## What Are the Recommended NMN Dosages?  
The suggested dose for nicotinamide mononucleotide is anywhere from 250 mg to 1500 mg per day.  
Dr David Sinclair PhD, a famous researcher in the biology of aging and genetics, publicly stated he takes 1g of NMN per day on a Joe Rogan podcast [interview](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HOTS0HS7aq4), which is the highest dose we came across someone taking per day.
